details.description: GPT-4o ("omni") is OpenAI's natively multimodal flagship model, first released May 13, 2024 with later dated snapshots through November 20, 2024. OpenAI's own model page describes it as its versatile, high-intelligence flagship model and the best model for most tasks outside the o-series reasoning line. As served through the Chat Completions API it takes text and image input and returns text output, with a 128,000-token context window and a knowledge cutoff of October 1, 2023. OpenAI retired GPT-4o from ChatGPT in February 2026, but it remains available through the API, where only the original 2024-05-13 snapshot is scheduled for shutdown, on October 23, 2026.
advantages: Scores 85.7% on MMLU and 33.2% on SWE-bench Verified (OpenAI's GPT-4.1 announcement, gpt-4o-2024-11-20 snapshot).
Scores 68.7% on the MMMU vision benchmark and 61.4% on MathVista (OpenAI).
OpenAI's original announcement reports response speed and non-English text handling improved over GPT-4 Turbo (OpenAI).
Supports function calling, web search, file search, code interpretation and MCP tool use through the Responses API (OpenAI API model docs).
disadvantages: Retired from ChatGPT in February 2026 after usage shifted to newer models; OpenAI's retirement post says only 0.1% of ChatGPT users were still choosing GPT-4o daily (OpenAI).
Knowledge cutoff of October 1, 2023, older than the GPT-4.1 family's June 2024 cutoff (OpenAI API model docs).

The Chat Completions model covered here takes text and image input and produces text-only output; the audio, video and native voice capabilities from OpenAI's original GPT-4o announcement are served through separate Realtime and Audio-preview model families, not this one.
use_cases: Complex, multi-step reasoning and analysis tasks
Vision-based tasks such as image understanding and interpretation

notes: This group's URIs span three gpt-4o snapshots (2024-05-13, 2024-08-06, 2024-11-20) across Azure regions and OpenAI direct; benchmark scores above are for the 2024-11-20 snapshot, the newest in the group, from OpenAI's GPT-4.1 comparison table. OpenAI's API deprecations page (raw HTML checked directly) schedules only the gpt-4o-2024-05-13 snapshot for shutdown, on October 23, 2026, substitute gpt-5.6-sol; the 2024-08-06 and 2024-11-20 snapshots in this group are not on that shutdown list. This roughly matches the catalog's earlier deprecation_date fact (2026-10-01) but the group also carries a later 2027-04-14 fact that no primary source confirmed. The ChatGPT-product retirement (Feb 2026) is separate from API availability and does not affect this API-served model directly. Pages under openai.com returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch and were read via the r.jina.ai reader proxy; cited URLs are the original OpenAI pages.
